blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Cottonwood. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Cottonwood, Maple Ridge: 55 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Cottonwood rose from 52 in June to 55 in September (+5.8%), and 19 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 13.4% of Maple Ridge’s 410 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Cottonwood?
Cottonwood also had 34 condos and townhomes listed and 4 sold in September, against 55 houses listed. The Cottonwood condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Cottonwood?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 55 houses listed in Cottonwood. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Cottonwood a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Cottonwood had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Cottonwood from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 19 houses sold in Cottonwood over those 4 months, out of 188 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Cottonwood?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
